Name: Baker's Life Continued
Author: Shads4242
Description:
[b]Languages Available Natively: [/b]English (US), Chinese (simplified), Korean,
[b]Languages Available via Separate Mod: [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30764/]Brazilian Pourtugese[/url]
[b]Documentation: [/b]An informational spreadsheet, including how to trigger each recipe, is located [url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1ombT6sixaDAR3g5Av5bw3l8DdIhtn1crJqazWJNi2Wg/edit?usp=sharing]here[/url]

[size=5][b][center]About[/center][/b][/size]
Baker's Life Continued is a continuation of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5213]Baker's Life[/url]﻿ by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Ritsunesan/about-me?gameId=1303]Ritsunesan[/url], fully rewritten to use Content Patcher and the Cornucopia family of mods. ﻿This mod is designed to be used with Stardew Valley 1.6, due to the deprecation of JSON Assets and PPJA. This mod preserves both the machines and the artisan goods from Baker's Life, with the exception of Molasses.
[b]
[/b][center][b]
[/b][size=5][b]Changes from the Original[/b][/size][/center]
[list]
[*]Molasses has been removed in favor of using the Molasses object from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24842]Cornucopia - Artisan Machines[/url]﻿
[*]All artisan good items have had "Baker's" dropped from their name. This is due to no longer needing to worry about the JSON shuffle
[*]Updated many object descriptions
[*]Updated gift tastes based on villager's likes and dislikes of crops and movie theatre concessions
[*]i18n support 
[*]"Baker's Cookies" has been renamed to "Chocolate Chip Cookies"
[*]Banana Bread and Zucchini Bread are now made with Dough rather than Cake Batter
[*]Items that required Starbrew Valley now use either vanilla alcohol or the Dark Ale from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24842]Cornucopia - Artisan Machines[/url]
[/list][center]﻿[/center][center]
[size=5][b]Planned Features for Future Updates[/b][/size][/center]
[list]
[*][size=2][s]Custom gift tastes for the villagers added via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url] (v2)[/s] completed[/size]
[*][size=2]Heavy restructuring of mod - this was my first mod ported, and I've learned a lot in the months since then that I want to implement (v3)[/size]
[*][size=2]New type of pie crust, a Cookie Crust made with Chocolate Cookies and Butter in the mixer (v4+)[/size]
[*][size=2]Addition of muffins, cupcakes, and bagels (v4+)[/size]
[*][size=2]more flavors ﻿of pie and cheesecake for all crusts (v4+)[/size]
[/list]
